body.purpose: Conversation text. Controls and navigation use 14px medium.

label.purpose: Uppercase kickers and tabs that are not sentences.

shadows.name: slash-menu
shadows.purpose: The menu above the composer. Opaque, bordered, and the only panel shadow.

shadows.name: map-pin
shadows.purpose: Halo on a trip marker, with a 2px white border. Not a surface shadow.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for control color and the 150ms state change.

motion.purpose: A pressed button moves down one pixel. It does not lift.

motion.purpose: When reduced motion is requested, durations collapse and the binary decode is removed.

narrative.overview:
Meridian is a private desk for one person and the model they already run. Night Study is the ground the app boots into, warm and dark. Warm Paper is the same desk with the lamp on. Fraunces is the nameplate. Geist is the work. The mood is quiet and warm, and a pop of color is welcome when it is Burnished Copper or Field Sage.

Depth is a step of tone. The drawer sits a shade under the canvas, a card sits a shade above it, and a hairline finishes the edge. Controls are short, gently curved, and they press down one pixel. Copper marks the action: buttons, icons, the active underline, links, selection, and the context meter. Sage marks what is reachable, live, or confirmed.

The desk refuses a hosted-product look. No purple brand, no neon, and no frosted panels. The composer dock and the dialog scrim are the only translucency, and both stay faint. The map's four colors stay on the map.
keyCharacteristics: Night Study by default, Warm Paper as the same desk with the lamp on
Fraunces for the name and section titles, Geist for the work, Geist Mono for tools and measures
Two pops of color: Burnished Copper for action and marks, Field Sage for live or confirmed
Tonal steps and hairlines, with shadow reserved for the slash menu and map pins
Compact controls: 32px buttons, 10px corners, and a 1px press

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Burnished Copper is the action and the mark. Field Sage is live, reachable, or confirmed. A pop of either is welcome. A third accent is not, and neither voice becomes a gradient or a glow.

rules.name: The Map Legend Rule
rules.body: Destination, stay, place, and transit colors exist only on the trip map and its key. They do not move into buttons, links, or chrome.

rules.name: The Nameplate Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for the product name and section titles. Sentences, controls, and lists are Geist. Tool names, file names, commands, and the context meter are Geist Mono.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: A label that is not a sentence is 11px, uppercase, and tracked out 0.14em.

rules.name: The Frame Rule
rules.body: The sidebar is 18.5rem, the desk is 24rem, and the conversation stops at 48rem. Under 48rem the sidebar covers the work. Under 80rem the desk covers the work.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: A surface changes depth by stepping to the next warm tone and drawing a hairline. It does not lift off the desk.

rules.name: The Floating Menu Rule
rules.body: The slash menu is the one panel that casts a shadow. Map pins are the one mark with a halo.

rules.name: The Three Corners Rule
rules.body: 10px for controls, 14px for panels and dialogs, 18px for the composer and your own messages. Pills are for chips and status.

dos: Do boot in Night Study. Warm Paper is the same desk with the lamp on.
Do use Burnished Copper for primary buttons, mark icons, the active underline, links, text selection, and the context meter.
Do use Field Sage for reachable, live, and confirmed.
Do keep conversation text at 15px on a 28px line, inside a column that stops at 48rem.
Do draw focus as a 3px ring at half the ring color, and move a pressed button down 1px.
Do leave motion short, and remove it when the person asks for reduced motion.
donts: Don't use purple, neon, or frosted glass on panels, cards, or menus.
Don't add a third accent. The map legend stays on the map.
Don't put drop shadows on cards, the sidebar, the desk, or dialogs.
Don't set Fraunces on buttons, inputs, labels, or body copy.
Don't grow controls, round them into pills, or lift them on hover.
